judgment.notes: I is uniquely the closed real unit interval, with both endpoints included. This is a total set definition with no existence guard or additional hypothesis; it agrees with the fixed problem and with the interval notation in the arguments.

F is exactly E×I in the coordinate Euclidean metric, not the default maximum product metric. The displayed square-root distance fixes the identification and projection/isometry meanings used later. n is a natural number, x,y,t,u are bound in this definition, and the empty coordinate vector convention covers n=0 without an extra guard. No compactness or nonemptiness is encoded in the definition.

The metric space, subset, positive exponent and finite positive real scale are explicitly typed. Extended diameter, empty costs, countable covers, empty padding, sums and infimum conventions completely specify Hscale without requiring measurable covering sets or existence of a finite-cost cover. Such finiteness is a separate N002 conclusion, not an implicit definition guard. Actual quantified uses have positive scales/exponents; auxiliary cover/projection families are introduced locally, with finite diameters obtained from their cover restrictions.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
